promptSummary: RUBRIC + the stored rung 2 research report. No tools. Return supportsNoOnlineOrdering, researchReason and sourceUrls.
teachingNote: A second call with no tools, over research that is already stored. Change the rubric and you re-run only this call; the expensive research does not move. Here rules 1 and 3 pass and rule 2 cannot be proven either way, so the rubric's false-when-unproven instruction decides the verdict, and the reason names the rule so a person knows what to check.
